# Point of Sale Setup - Categories

# POS Category Filter

The Category Filter lets you control which products from your POS system (Lightspeed or Square) are imported into OrderHub. By default, every product in a sale is imported — but when this filter is enabled, only products belonging to categories you specify will come through.

## How It Works

- When a sale is completed in your POS, OrderHub receives the full list of products
- If the Category Filter is **off** (default), all products are imported as jobs
- If the Category Filter is **on**, each product's category is checked against your allowed list
- Only products with a matching category are created as jobs in OrderHub
- Products with categories **not** in your list are silently ignored
- If **none** of the products in a sale match your allowed categories, the entire order is skipped — no empty orders are created

## Setting It Up

1. Navigate to **Admin Setup** (/admin-setup)
2. Scroll down to your **POS Integration** settings (Lightspeed or Square)
3. Find the **Category Filter** section
4. Toggle the switch to **enable** the filter
5. Type a category name into the text field and click **Add** (or press Enter)
6. Repeat for each category you want to allow
7. Categories take effect immediately — no need to click Save separately

## Tips

- Category names are **not case-sensitive** — "Photo Prints" and "photo prints" will both match
- The category name must match **exactly** what is set in your POS system (aside from capitalisation)
- You can remove a category at any time by clicking the **✕** button next to it
- If you're unsure what categories exist in your POS, check your product setup in Lightspeed or Square
- Turning the filter **off** will immediately resume importing all products — your saved categories are kept for if you turn it back on
